prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing
Asset type: wide photographic website hero banner for the Primoris Academy school calendar page, landscape 3:1 composition.
Primary request: an elegant school-year planning still life, warm, welcoming and academically curious, appropriate for a school website.
Scene: overhead editorial photograph of a deep muted teal desk (#164d57), with a cream paper monthly calendar planner, a slim notebook, a couple of natural wood pencils, small lime-green stationery accents (#87b840), a few autumn leaves and a small fresh green leaf. The planner has understated blank grid cells and a few subtle circular colored markers, with absolutely no words or numerals.
Composition: wide panoramic banner; keep the left 45 percent a quiet uninterrupted teal surface with soft natural shadows so the website can overlay a white page title. Arrange the stationery mainly on the right, with generous breathing room. Keep the subjects in the central horizontal band so the image crops gracefully into a short banner on desktop and on mobile. Real paper grain, refined minimal styling, soft daylight from upper right, natural imperfect material textures, premium editorial photography.
Constraints: no people, no logos, no watermarks, no text, no letters, no numerals, no interface mockup, no borders. This is a decorative background image, not the full webpage.
